boundaries: Corners are tentative visible-image LCD/aperture metadata, not hidden manufacturing corners.
A nondegenerate numerically stable homography does not validate the corner picks as physical truth.
Unit-rectangle normalization does not imply a 480x640 OEM framebuffer or any physical aspect ratio.
Corner perturbation sensitivity is deterministic numerical sensitivity, not a calibrated confidence interval.
P07 dividerX values are photo-space observations with unquantified divider measurement uncertainty; P09 perturbs corners only.
Lens distortion/intrinsics/coplanar physical scale remain unknown.
No crops, warps, rectified images or OEM pixel derivatives are created or saved.

method.dividerTransform: for the five photos with a P07 photo-space dividerX, intersect x=dividerX with tentative top/bottom LCD edges, transform both endpoints, report normalized top/bottom/mid fraction and tilt
method.homographySolver: Hartley-normalized four-point DLT via NumPy SVD

nondegenerateChecks.note: loose numerical-degeneracy gates only; not calibration quality thresholds

method.uncertaintySensitivity: 16 deterministic one-corner axial +/- stated uncertainty variants per rater/photo plus 9 nominal interior probes

betweenRater.interpretation: two uncalibrated image-space annotations; not calibrated residuals and not to be averaged

dividerSensitivity.note: corner-uncertainty sensitivity only; P07 dividerX measurement uncertainty is not independently quantified

sensitivity.perturbationRule: 16 axial variants: one corner at a time, +/- stated uncertainty along x or y; deterministic, not Monte Carlo

p07DividerNormalization.boundary: same P07 photo-space dividerX transformed through two tentative corner homographies; no physical/OEM truth claim
